response.passage: Welcome to 'Ramesh’s Chat Corner', located near the bustling Gandhi Market. We have been serving the community since 1998. Many customers ask us why our spicy aloo tikki is so popular. The secret is simple: we use a special blend of spices sourced directly from the hills of Ooty. Because we fry the tikkis in pure desi ghee, they develop a unique, golden-brown crunch that keeps people coming back. Our head chef, Sunita, manages the stall every day from 4 PM to 9 PM. We currently offer 12 different types of snacks on our menu. Some visitors mistakenly believe that 'chat' refers only to casual conversation, but here it refers to our savory street food. Please note that we do not accept digital payments, as our small stall operates entirely on cash to ensure quick service for everyone in the queue.
response.summary: Ramesh’s Chat Corner is a popular street food stall near Gandhi Market known for its spicy aloo tikki. The stall uses high-quality ingredients and operates during evening hours. They focus on cash transactions to maintain efficiency.
